Voidwalkers (or void walkers) are a type of void creature. Large shapeless things in hues of blue and purple, they hover ominously. Despite being fleshless, they do have souls. Enigmatic and emanating intense shadow, a voidwalker is sometimes the last thing someone encounters before crossing over into the realm of death. Touching them has been compared to the burning feeling of frostbite, and their grips strong enough to crush bone into powder. Although they aren't demons, they are sometimes referred to as such and classified for gameplay reasons.
A Void Crystal is an ingredient for high level enchantments, and some high level crafting items.
Void Sphere is crafted with Enchanting (350); taught by trainers.

, a named Voidcaller]] Voidcallers are a type of voidwalker that look to be draped in old, rotting cloth. Voidcallers are spell-casting voidwalkers. They carry over their draped shoulders two lanterns that bridge the realms of the living and the dead, and often attract wayward ghosts and spirits. These lanterns hang from a glowing crystal-like structure that strongly resembles parts of a naaru. Voidcallers' specific relationship with naaru is unclear; in exceedingly rare cases, the naaru are known to fall into a void state. For discussion of the connection between voidcallers, voidwalkers and the naaru, see Naaru-voidwalker relationship.

.]] Voidwraiths are a slender type of voidwalker. They were first found in Netherstorm and on the Isle of Quel'Danas, as in the case of Zereketh the Unbound. Voidwraiths seem to be rarer than other voidwalkers and rarely talk. In What the Soul Sees, ancient orc spirits coalesced into the darkened naaru D'ore's essence in Oshu'gun, to stop the spirits becoming creatures of the void a Soul Mirror is used to cause a soul split extracting Darkened Spirit voidwraiths freeing the ancestor orc spirits.

The unforgiving desert of Vol'dun is one of the three regions of Zandalar. Previously a vibrant and lush jungle, Vol'dun is now a virtually uninhabitable, vast sea of dunes dreaded by all Zandalari, for to be exiled to its endless wastes is a sure sentence of death. And yet somehow, the wily nomads known as the vulpera have managed to eke out an existence here, despite facing a constant threat from the sethrak, a brutal snakelike race determined to reign over this arid wasteland.

Vok'fon is a jungle troll primal and a bandit. He is a son of Master Vornal and an outcast from the Darkspear tribe because he openly spoke against the Horde that they would make the Darkspears weak. He is described as a barbaric warrior. He and his group of bandits once attacked Brann Bronzebeard and his group, leaving Brann as the only survivor and taking him as prisoner. As the dwarf fought as a true warrior, the troll treated him with respect and honor. During the following days, sharing conversations with them, Brann learned much about the troll races, history and organizations from Vok'fon and his comrades. Volatile Felfire Fiends are elite Fel imps located in the Sunwell Plateau of the Isle of Quel'Danas. They can also be spotted from the Magisters' Terrace by using the Scrying Orb located at The Solar Vigil. In the Sunwell Plateau they guard the stretch before M'uru.
Volatile Fiends are elite Fel imps located in the Sunwell Plateau of the Isle of Quel'Danas. They are found near the entrance and terrace, and also spawn endlessly at the gauntlet area after Felmyst.

Vorsh was a bald forest troll belonging to Gree's tribe. He helped capture Vereesa Windrunner and Falstad Dragonreaver, but died in a battle against hill dwarves — the rescuers of Vereesa and Falstad.

Volatile Ghouls are ghouls located at Havenshire in the Scarlet Enclave.

Voltarus is a Scourge necropolis located in the northwest of Zul'Drak, which hovers above blighted pools of plague known as the Reliquary of Pain, near the border with the Storm Peaks. During the war against the Lich King, after he betrayed his own people to the Lich King, Overlord Drakuru was given control over the necropolis Voltarus. From there, Drakuru had a plan to infuse captured troll chieftains with blight and transform them into misshapen weapons in his efforts to conquer all of Zul'Drak for the Scourge.
Volkhan's Hood drops from Volkhan in the Halls of Lightning on normal mode.
__NOTOC__ Volatile Blasting Trigger is a component for Engineering.

Voldrune is a vrykul village southeast of Conquest Hold in the Grizzly Hills. It is the only vrykul village in the region, and they built it on the highest ground they could find. Voldrune belongs to the Dragonflayer clan. After the war against the Jailer, the brothers Bronzebeard reported that the vrykul have been fair quiet in recent days, and assumed it is due to the Horde troops in Conquest Hold.
Volunteer Work is a dungeon & raids achievement earned for defeating Jedoga Shadowseeker in Ahn'kahet on Heroic difficulty without killing any Twilight Volunteers.
Vordrassil's Seeds are found on the ground outside the small village near Grizzlemaw, as well as several areas within Grizzlemaw in the Grizzly Hills.
Volazj's Quick Demise is a dungeon & raids achievement earned for defeating Herald Volazj in Ahn'kahet on Heroic difficulty in 2 minutes or less.
Volatile Acid is provided as an objective by Thassarian for Before the Gate of Horror (Alliance), and by Koltira Deathweaver for Before the Gate of Horror (Horde).
Voldrethar, Dark Blade of Oblivion drops from General Vezax in 25-man version of Ulduar on Hard Mode.
Vordrassil's Ashes are obtained by using the Verdant Torch on the Vordrassil sapling at the center of Grizzlemaw.
Volgur follows Thane Illskar at the Circle of Suffering in the Underhalls of Icecrown.

Volatile Life is the new Eternal Life or Primal Life and Black Lotus, Fel Lotus or Frost Lotus replacement of Cataclysm.
Volatile Water is the new Eternal Water or Primal Water of Cataclysm.
